title: The troubleshooting row says an empty higher-precedence value can make the sweep never run
text: The troubleshooting row says an empty higher-precedence value can make the sweep never run. This contradicts the plan’s AC18 rule that an empty/whitespace higher-precedence value defers to the lower-precedence source; if that lower source is `on`, the sweep must run. Correct the diagnosis and remediation so the runbook has one unambiguous precedence contract.
rationale: Real defect: the flagged lines changed in 6dd737d, the next commit. Ronda v0.2.0 posted no matching finding on this head. Plan PR counted in scope: Ronda reviews plan PRs and reports no findings. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
